text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Do you two have your things?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm perfect. And full of respect and sincerity!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm full of deep feelings of admiration!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To the kind person we owe so much to!

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: We have the deepest gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I sure hope King will like this teacup I made…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I used too much force and crushed quite a few earlier attempts. But I was finally able to finish it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Of course she'll like it! Just hearing about how hard you worked shows that you made it with love!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But looking at my gift… Maybe a keychain is a little too childish for a grown-up like Maruzen…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You searched far and wide to get your hands on that keychain! It even has a mini version of her car.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I guess I'm kind of nervous too. Tachyon is really talented, so maybe this aromatherapy set is a little plain…

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so anxious! Oh, this is nerve-racking! Oh, my heart's racing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, that's what we've been called here for… I feel a sudden urge to depart.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Maybe we've arrived too early?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Oh, they're just so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But it's strange. I feel this kind of close connection with Chiyo. And not just when we run… It's like I can't take my eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, I understand that feeling. Whenever I'm with Kawakami, it's like I lose all sense. I can't help but look after her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm… On that thought, perhaps what you're describing could be feelings of affinity? I believe I have had similar experiences.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, let's keep what we just heard between us. If they find out we were here, I bet their little knees would buckle!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're right… Pretending not to notice would be the first-rate thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: While I would like to measure their heart rates upon telling them they were overheard… I'll have to save that experiment for another day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, they're here! Together, on the count of three. One, two…

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Thank you for being there for me!
